steps.action: Find the card 'Requests from the app'
user_sees: The member's name

Buttons 'Decline' and 'Approve'
must_not: Requests of another gym
A pause shown without its dates or day count

steps.action: Tap 'Approve'
user_sees: 'Saving…'; every button on the card is off
must_not: A second approval started by a second tap

steps.action: Wait
user_sees: The row stays, without buttons: 'Paused by <name>. Plan now ends <date>.'

start: Owner on Today; a member asked in the app to renew with a plan that is on sale

steps.action: Read the row
user_sees: 'Renew: <plan name>'
'The member pays at the desk. Approving adds the fee to what they owe.'
must_not: A price or a payment button on the row

steps.action: Tap 'Approve'
user_sees: 'Renewed by <name>: <first day> - <last day>. Collect the fee at the desk.'
must_not: A receipt written (nothing is collected here)
Two plans sold for one request
A start date that overlaps the plan they already have

steps.action: Open the member's page
user_sees: The new plan with the note 'Asked in the app (app #<8 letters>)' and its full price shown as still to pay
must_not: The plan shown as paid
The sale recorded without who sold it

start: Owner on Today with requests that cannot be approved

steps.action: Tap 'Decline' on a request
user_sees: 'Declined by <name>.'; no plan is changed
must_not: Days added or a plan sold on a decline

steps.action: Approve a pause for a member with no gym plan (PT only, or all cancelled)
user_sees: 'This member has no gym plan to pause. Decline it, or sell a plan first.'
must_not: A PT pack extended instead

steps.action: Approve a renewal whose plan was switched off or is a PT plan
user_sees: 'That plan is no longer on sale. Decline it, or sell another plan from the member’s page.'
must_not: An off-sale plan sold

steps.action: Approve for a member who was removed from the list
user_sees: 'This member is not on your list any more. Decline it.'
must_not: A plan made for a member who is not there

steps.action: Approve a request someone else answered, or one the member took back
user_sees: 'Someone already answered this request. The list is up to date now.' / 'This request is no longer there. The member may have taken it back.'
must_not: A raw code such as ALREADY_DECIDED or GONE on screen

start: Owner; the internet drops right after the plan was changed but before the server took the approval

steps.action: See the result of the first 'Approve'
user_sees: 'Could not save. Check the internet and try again.' or 'Not saved yet. Check the internet and press Approve again.'; the row still has its buttons
must_not: The row shown as approved

steps.action: Turn the internet on and tap 'Approve' again
user_sees: The row turns to 'Paused by …' or 'Renewed by …'
must_not: The pause days added a second time
A second plan sold for the same request

steps.action: Look at the card later
user_sees: Waiting requests first (oldest on top), then answered ones (newest first) without buttons; with no requests at all the card is not shown
must_not: An answered request getting its buttons back
An approved pause whose days were later removed still reading 'Paused'

user_sees: A notification that the pause or renewal was approved, and the new last day in the app

'Pause 3 Nov 2026 - 9 Nov 2026 (7 days)'
Buttons 'Decline' and 'Approve'
must_not: Requests of another gym
A pause shown without its dates or day count

steps.action: Tap 'Approve'
user_sees: 'Saving…'; every button on the card is off
must_not: A second approval started by a second tap

steps.action: Wait
user_sees: The row stays, without buttons: 'Paused by <name>. Plan now ends <date>.'
The member's gym plan ends 7 days later; its note says '+7 days (Freeze - asked in the app (app #<8 letters>))'
must_not: The days added twice
The days added to a PT pack, a cancelled plan, or a plan that is not the one ending last
The request marked approved while the plan was not changed
Cut-off text, a button off the screen, sideways scrolling, or two things on top of each other

note: Name, request line, note and two buttons in one row
